::: {.kpi-row #kpi-row}

## 📅 캘린더 — 일별 commit 분포

```{=html}
<div class="viz-container">
  <div style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
    <label for="org-filter" style="font-weight:500; margin-right:8px;">Org 필터:</label>
    <select id="org-filter" style="padding:4px 8px; border:1px solid var(--aa-snu-border); border-radius:4px;">
      <option value="all">전체 (All)</option>
      <option value="snuconnectome">snuconnectome</option>
      <option value="Transconnectome">Transconnectome</option>
      <option value="neurox-org">neurox-org</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div id="calendar"></div>
</div>
```

Single-color teal heatmap. Org 필터로 단일 조직 활동 패턴 분리 가능. 마감일 직전 burst는 색 농도로 즉시 식별.

## 🌊 스트림 — 카테고리별 활동 흐름

```{=html}
<div class="viz-container">
  <div id="stream"></div>
</div>
```

Repo 카테고리(proposal · paper · education · tool · other)별 누적 흐름. 본인 시간 무게중심이 어디로 흐르는지 한눈에 보입니다.

## 📦 카테고리 분포

```{=html}
<div class="viz-container">
  <div id="category-bars"></div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<script type="module">
import * as Plot from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@observablehq/plot@0.6.16/+esm";
import * as d3 from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7/+esm";

const commits = await fetch("data/raw/commits.json").then(r => r.json());

// ─── KPI tiles ────────────────────────────────────────────
const distinctRepos = new Set(commits.map(c => `${c.org}/${c.repo}`)).size;
const distinctWeeks = new Set(commits.map(c => {
  const d = new Date(c.author_date);
  const onejan = new Date(d.getFullYear(), 0, 1);
  const week = Math.ceil(((d - onejan) / 86400000 + onejan.getDay() + 1) / 7);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-W${week}`;
})).size;
const lastCommit = commits[0]?.author_date?.slice(0, 10) ?? "—";

document.getElementById("kpi-row").innerHTML = `
  <div class="kpi-tile"><div class="label">Total commits</div><div class="value">${commits.length}</div></div>
  <div class="kpi-tile"><div class="label">Repos active</div><div class="value">${distinctRepos}</div></div>
  <div class="kpi-tile"><div class="label">Active weeks</div><div class="value">${distinctWeeks}</div></div>
  <div class="kpi-tile"><div class="label">Last commit</div><div class="value" style="font-size:1.1rem;">${lastCommit}</div></div>
`;

// ─── Calendar heatmap (single-color teal + org filter) ────
// Build full date domain to show empty days too (better visual density)
const dateExtent = d3.extent(commits, c => new Date(c.author_date));
const dayDomain = [];
if (dateExtent[0]) {
  const start = d3.utcMonday(dateExtent[0]);
  const end = d3.utcMonday.offset(d3.utcMonday(new Date()), 1);
  for (let d = new Date(start); d < end; d = d3.utcDay.offset(d, 1)) {
    dayDomain.push(new Date(d));
  }
}
const weekStrings = [...new Set(dayDomain.map(d => d3.utcFormat("%Y-W%V")(d)))].sort();

// Choose week labels — show first week of each month
const monthMarkers = new Map();
for (const w of weekStrings) {
  const sampleDay = dayDomain.find(d => d3.utcFormat("%Y-W%V")(d) === w);
  if (sampleDay) {
    const monthKey = d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m")(sampleDay);
    if (!monthMarkers.has(monthKey)) {
      monthMarkers.set(monthKey, { week: w, label: d3.utcFormat("%b '%y")(sampleDay) });
    }
  }
}
const tickWeeks = new Set([...monthMarkers.values()].map(m => m.week));

function renderCalendar(orgFilter = "all") {
  const filtered = orgFilter === "all" ? commits : commits.filter(c => c.org === orgFilter);
  const byDay = d3.rollup(filtered, v => v.length, c => c.author_date.slice(0, 10));

  // Fill all days in domain so empty cells appear
  const data = dayDomain.map(d => {
    const key = d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m-%d")(d);
    return {
      date: d,
      count: byDay.get(key) ?? 0,
      weekday: d.getUTCDay(),
      week: d3.utcFormat("%Y-W%V")(d),
    };
  });

  const target = document.getElementById("calendar");
  target.innerHTML = "";
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 980,
    height: 200,
    marginLeft: 60,
    marginRight: 20,
    marginBottom: 40,
    color: {
      scheme: "blues",
      type: "linear",
      legend: true,
      label: "commits/day",
      domain: [0, Math.max(1, d3.max(data, d => d.count) || 1)],
    },
    x: {
      axis: "bottom",
      label: null,
      domain: weekStrings,
      tickFormat: w => (tickWeeks.has(w) ? monthMarkers.get(d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m")(dayDomain.find(d => d3.utcFormat("%Y-W%V")(d) === w)))?.label : ""),
      ticks: weekStrings.filter(w => tickWeeks.has(w)),
    },
    y: {
      tickFormat: d => ["일", "월", "화", "수", "목", "금", "토"][d],
      label: null,
      domain: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0],  // Mon-first ordering
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.cell(data, {
        x: "week",
        y: "weekday",
        fill: "count",
        title: d => `${d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m-%d")(d.date)}\n${d.count} commit${d.count === 1 ? "" : "s"}`,
        inset: 1,
      }),
    ],
    style: {
      background: "transparent",
      fontFamily: "var(--aa-font-en)",
    },
  });
  target.appendChild(chart);
}

renderCalendar();
document.getElementById("org-filter").addEventListener("change", e => renderCalendar(e.target.value));

// ─── Stream graph by category ─────────────────────────────
const byMonthCat = d3.rollups(
  commits,
  v => v.length,
  c => d3.timeFormat("%Y-%m")(new Date(c.author_date)),
  c => c.repo_category,
);
const streamData = [];
byMonthCat.forEach(([month, catRolls]) => {
  catRolls.forEach(([cat, n]) => {
    streamData.push({ month: new Date(month + "-01"), category: cat, n });
  });
});

const catColors = {
  proposal: "#003380",
  paper: "#0072B2",
  education: "#009E73",
  tool: "#D55E00",
  other: "#CC79A7",
  core: "#5A5A6E",
};

const streamChart = Plot.plot({
  width: 980,
  height: 320,
  marginLeft: 40,
  marginRight: 120,
  x: { type: "time", label: "month" },
  y: { label: "commits", grid: true },
  color: {
    domain: Object.keys(catColors),
    range: Object.values(catColors),
    legend: true,
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(streamData, {
      x: "month",
      y: "n",
      z: "category",
      fill: "category",
      curve: "catmull-rom",
      tip: true,
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
  ],
  style: {
    background: "transparent",
    fontFamily: "var(--aa-font-en)",
  },
});
document.getElementById("stream").appendChild(streamChart);

// ─── Category bars ────────────────────────────────────────
const catCounts = d3.rollups(commits, v => v.length, c => c.repo_category)
  .map(([category, n]) => ({ category, n }))
  .sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n);

const barChart = Plot.plot({
  width: 980,
  height: 280,
  marginLeft: 90,
  x: { label: "commits" },
  y: { label: null, domain: catCounts.map(c => c.category) },
  color: {
    domain: Object.keys(catColors),
    range: Object.values(catColors),
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(catCounts, {
      x: "n",
      y: "category",
      fill: "category",
      tip: true,
    }),
    Plot.text(catCounts, {
      x: "n",
      y: "category",
      text: d => d.n,
      dx: 8,
      textAnchor: "start",
      fontWeight: 600,
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([0]),
  ],
  style: {
    background: "transparent",
    fontFamily: "var(--aa-font-en)",
  },
});
document.getElementById("category-bars").appendChild(barChart);
</script>
```
